title: Isha Upanishad
summary: The Isha Upanishad is one of the shortest Upanishads, focusing on the omnipresence of the Divine and the need for balance between spiritual and worldly knowledge.

verses.sanskrit:
ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् |
तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ||
verses.translation: All this, whatever moves in this moving world, is enveloped by God. Therefore, find your enjoyment in renunciation; do not covet what belongs to others.
verses.transliteration:
īśāvāsyam idaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiñca jagatyāṃ jagat
tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasya svid dhanam
verses.meaning: īśā—by the Lord; vāsyam—to be enveloped; idam—this; sarvam—all...
